title: Spec Kit clarify: up to 5 questions

parts.text: Detect and reduce ambiguity or missing decision points in the feature spec, and record the answers in the spec file.
Ask at most 5 questions across the whole session. Each takes a choice of 2 to 5 options or a short answer of 5 words or fewer.
Question 1: Run clarification before the technical plan, or skip it?
Why it matters: skipping raises the risk of downstream rework.
Clarification is expected to run before the plan.

else.text: B: skip clarification, for an exploratory spike

parts.text: Proceed with a warning that downstream rework risk increases.
Question 2: Which unresolved category with high impact is asked about first?
Why it matters: the question quota is 5, so the top categories by impact times uncertainty go first.

else.text: B: Edge cases and failure handling

parts.text: Question 3: What measurable target replaces the word "robust"?
Why it matters: an ambiguous adjective cannot be tested. Format: short answer, 5 words or fewer.

pick.text: Suggested: a number with a unit

parts.text: After the last answer: proceed to the plan, or run clarify again later after the plan?

pick.text: A (Recommended): proceed to the technical plan

else.text: B: run clarify again after the plan

parts.text: Outstanding or Deferred categories stay flagged.
